reasoning: The tomato leaf displays numerous small (1-2mm), dark brown to near-black specks randomly scattered across the leaf surface with some marginal yellowing. This pattern is characteristic of Bacterial Speck of Tomato (Pseudomonas syringae pv. tomato), which produces tiny dark lesions on leaves. The spots are too small and uniformly dark for Septoria Leaf Blotch (which has tan centers with pycnidia) and lack the concentric ring pattern of Early Blight.
